Drinking a Draught of Midnight while the [[Mabar Endless Night Festival|Festival of Endless Night]] is active will grant a chance to collect Pieces of Darkest Chocolate when fighting undead anywhere. While in [[Delera's Graveyard]], you may also collect Pieces of Darkest Chocolate from certain other creatures, such as Succubi and Shadar-kai. This effect lasts for one hour.
  | notes       =<nowiki />
** "Draught" is pronounced ''draft''.
** {{Bug|term={{Red|1='''Bug Warning:'''}}|Drink these {{Big|1=<u>{{Smallcaps|1=only ''one''}} at a time</u>}} as they do not stack duration like similar potions.}}
** In Delera's Graveyard, this potion grants a chance (perhaps around 20%) to get 1 to 12 extra chocolates ''for each kill that you personally make''. These chocolates are in addition to the usual chocolate drops.
** Additionally, it makes chocolate drop from undead kills anywhere in game. Lesser to none effect reported in other areas ({{Forums|p=5720441|label=2015}})
** Draught does not yield extra keys{{Ref|{{Developer|Steelstar}} on {{Forums|p=5711379}}}}.

;Older reports

* [[The Haunted Halls of Eveningstar|Haunted Halls]] yields lots from the zombies (Epic Normal run - observed rate in excess of 3,000 per hour)
